# Complete project-file audit

Audit date: 2026-09-02

The source project contained 40 non-generated files and 13 generated Python
bytecode files. Every non-generated file has a representation in this public
backup. Files marked **sanitized** preserve their implementation or document
content while replacing environment-specific operational metadata.

## What was sensitive in the raw files

The raw authoritative documents and environment-rendered files did not contain
the Gemini or Supabase key values. They did contain operationally sensitive
metadata: exact public/internal hosts, production webhook and workflow IDs,
n8n credential record IDs, the Supabase project endpoint, private backup paths,
legacy plaintext-key source/inventory locations, internal DocType names, and
live workflow version IDs. Those values are replaced in this public backup.
